data_snapshot.basis: frozen old proxy, diagnostic only; formal historical accuracy N/A

cost_model.description: Official old close-model: dated member turnover, 0.3% entry/exit, theoretical 0.8x index short plus 0.0003 daily drag; TV/cash yield/financing OFF. Not common-cash executable account.
cost_model.cost_total_semantics: sum of daily cost rates, not currency or percentage of initial capital

normalization.source: core_executor/scan_summary.csv plus all 14 real daily/*.csv.gz streams
normalization.ann_return: annual_pct / 100, independently checked from daily NAV with 244/number_of_returns
normalization.max_dd: max_drawdown_pct / 100, independently checked from daily NAV with initial capital high-water mark 1
normalization.sharpe_repo: ann_return / ann_vol when positive volatility; otherwise 0

parity_check: Core formal daily replay vs frozen official v2.3: return max 9.99e-17, NAV max 3.55e-15; normalized annual/DD from daily checked 1e-12 for every candidate/window
warnings: L5 common-cash account and real futures execution incomplete
